policy.purpose: Index immutable live forecast snapshots retained for cross-version ChaseLights replay.
policy.ground_truth_boundary: A baseline snapshot is forecast evidence only. observation.status=unreviewed means it is not an FV field-validation case and contains no claim that the photographed scene was observed.
policy.mutation_boundary: Archive payloads are immutable. New captures create new snapshot IDs; existing baseline payloads must not be rewritten to match later scoring logic.

limitations: Forecast-valid local time is 01:00, so the final P03 Opportunity is outside the visible-light Theme window even though the Qingshui coastal-mist runtime itself is eligible.
Spatial targets are environmental proxy points and do not prove fog overlapped the cliff or the intended composition.
No field photograph or observed-scene assessment is attached; this baseline must remain outside the field-validation registry.
The archived payload preserves the live provider response seen during capture, but provider forecasts can be revised later.
